notes.title: Unknown – Foggins: Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662788/1d3e94479d936fb0e9abc7b8357a5ba339e6ac86.png"][/img]🎉 The demo version of [u][i][b]Unknown: Foggins[/b][/i][/u], the second story in the [u][i][b]Unknown[/b][/i][/u] series, is now available![/p][p]
🎮 Try it out now on your preferred platform - [b]Steam[/b], [b]Play Store[/b], [b]App Store[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Estimated playtime (demo):[/b] ~1 hour 30 minutes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Estimated full game length:[/b] ~9 hours (excluding behind-the-scenes content)[/p][/*][/list][p]
Recently, the [b][i][u]Unknown[/u][/i][/b] series has been at the center of plagiarism controversy on Korean Twitter, due to perceived similarities with [b][i][u]Rusty Lake[/u][/i][/b].
In response, we decided to release the demo earlier than originally planned in order to gather honest and objective feedback from our players.[/p][p]Please note that some elements—such as the intro, cutscenes, and sound—are still a work in progress. We kindly ask for your understanding.[/p][p]
If you encounter bugs, have suggestions, or simply want to share your thoughts, feel free to post them in our Discord or community discussion forums.
Your feedback will be invaluable as we continue refining the game.[/p][p]
Thank you![/p]
